title.narrative: Support to Ethical AI Governance Frameworks in Lebanon and Syria

description.narrative: This activity provides technical and programmatic support to advance ethical artificial intelligence governance frameworks in Lebanon and Syria, drawing on UNESCO's Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence. Support will be tailored to the specific needs and readiness of national authorities in each country, and may include conducting AI Readiness Assessments, strengthening national institutional capacities, supporting the development or implementation of national AI strategies and policies, and connecting national authorities to UNESCO's global AI ethics networks for peer learning and knowledge exchange. Countries considered under this activity are Lebanon and Syria.
